params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$r='C:\Users\Xxkan\local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
$wt='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\workflow-backend-probe'
$branch='integration/complete-mod-workflows-backend-20260929'
git -C $r fetch origin --prune | Out-Null
if(Test-Path $wt){git -C $r worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null|Out-Null}
git -C $r worktree prune | Out-Null
git -C $r show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$branch"
if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){git -C $r branch -D $branch|Out-Null}
git -C $r worktree add -b $branch $wt origin/main | Out-Host
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'worktree add failed'}
$files=@(
'src/MhwModManager.Automation/FomodInstallerService.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.Automation/RulesEditorService.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.Automation/UpdateMigrationService.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.Core/GameAdapters.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.Core/WorkflowAnalysis.cs',
'tests/MhwModManager.AutomationTests/WorkflowTests.cs'
)
foreach($f in $files){
  git -C $wt checkout origin/codex/complete-mod-workflows -- $f
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "checkout failed $f"}
}
git -C $wt diff --check
$diffCheck=$LASTEXITCODE
$testOut=Join-Path $wt 'BuildLogs\workflow-backend-probe-test.log'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $testOut -Parent)|Out-Null
& dotnet test (Join-Path $wt 'tests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests.csproj') -c Release *> $testOut
$testExit=$LASTEXITCODE
$tail=@(Get-Content $testOut -Tail 180 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
[pscustomobject]@{
  main=(git -C $wt rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
  branch=$branch
  diff_check=$diffCheck
  test_exit=$testExit
  status=@(git -C $wt status --short)
  errors=@($tail)
}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
